lines.japanese: オーケイ、さりげなく行ってみよう。

lines.english: “Oh! Actually, now that I think about it...”

lines.japanese: 「えーっと、そういえば、いま日和子さんはどちらに？」
「どちらに……って、もちろん下で働いてるよ、ふつーに。休み時間、私たちとずれてるから」
lines.english: “Where...? Downstairs working, obviously. Her break's at a different time from ours.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、なるほど。たしか昨日も紀奈子さんと英里子さんがペアで……んで、日和子さんはひとりで休憩取ってましたよね」
lines.english: “Ah, I see. Yesterday too, you and Eriko took your break together... while Hiyoko took hers alone, didn't she?”

lines.japanese: 「え、ちょっと待てよ。なにそれ、うちらが疎外してるみたく言うなよ」
lines.english: “Hey, wait. Don't make it sound like we're freezing her out.”

lines.japanese: 「うーん、昔は声かけてたんだけどね。でも、なんだか、ひよちゃんはひとりで本読んだりするのが好きみたいだから……」
lines.english: “Hmm. We used to invite her, you know. But Hiyo seems to prefer sitting alone with a book...”

lines.japanese: 「ひとりが好きっつーか、他人が嫌いなんじゃない？」
lines.english: Maybe it's less that she likes being alone and more that she hates other people?

lines.japanese: それは……まあ、頷けるような気もしますが……どうなんでしょう。
lines.english: That... did seem plausible, in a way. But who could say?

lines.japanese: 「てゆか、ほら、三人いっぺんに休んじゃったらフロア大変だっぺ？」
lines.english: “Besides, if all three of us take a break at once, the floor’s going to be swamped, isn’t it?”

lines.japanese: なんとなく後付けのフォローに聞こえなくもないけど、たしかにそれも事実のはず。
lines.english: It did sound a little like an excuse tacked on after the fact, but it was probably true too.

lines.japanese: 「ま、どーでもいいけどね。休憩時間なんだから、そんなん、本人がいちばん休める方法で休みゃーいいし。べつにどうこう言う気はないよ」
lines.english: “Well, whatever. It’s her break, so she should spend it however lets her rest best. I’m not gonna tell her what to do.”

lines.japanese: いちばん休める方法──それが日和子さんの場合、ひとりで読書なのか。ははあ、なるほど。
lines.english: So for Hiyoko, the best way to recharge was reading alone. Ah-ha. I understood.
